description: This Java source file defines the DefaultDummyService class which implements the DummyService interface. It provides a process method that transforms a DummyRequest into a DummyResponse, converting content to uppercase and associating it with tenant information.

classes.name: DefaultDummyService
classes.description: Implementation of DummyService that processes DummyRequest objects to generate DummyResponse objects, utilizing tenant service to include tenant information.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Converts a DummyRequest into a DummyResponse by transforming the content to uppercase and attaching tenant information.
